sectionBadge.base: inline-block rounded-full border border-gold/30 bg-navy/50 backdrop-blur-sm px-4 py-1
sectionBadge.text: text-xs font-sans font-medium tracking-[0.2em] text-gold uppercase

statCard.wrapper: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center group

number.base: font-serif text-5xl md:text-6xl text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gold-gradient mb-2

statCard.label: font-sans text-sm tracking-widest text-cream/80 uppercase

processStep.number: font-serif text-6xl text-gold/20 absolute -top-8 -left-4 md:static md:mb-4
processStep.title: font-serif text-xl text-white mb-2

testimonialCard.wrapper: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-8 md:p-10 rounded-sm hover:border-gold/30 transition-colors duration-300
testimonialCard.quote: font-serif italic text-lg text-cream/90 mb-6 leading-relaxed

author.avatar: w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border border-gold/50
author.name: font-sans text-sm font-bold text-white

serviceCard.wrapper: group relative h-full bg-navy-light p-8 border border-white/5 hover:border-gold/50 transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden
serviceCard.icon: w-12 h-12 text-gold mb-6 group-hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300
serviceCard.title: font-serif text-2xl text-white mb-4
serviceCard.featureItem: flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-500 group-hover:text-gold/80

ctaBanner.content: relative z-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-4 py-24 md:py-32
ctaBanner.button: mt-8 px-8 py-4 bg-gold hover:bg-white text-navy font-sans font-bold tracking-widest transition-colors duration-300 uppercase text-sm

classes.textShimmer: animate-shimmer bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/50 to-transparent bg-[length:200%_100%]
